name: geology-gaps
description: Terrain DEM bbox [10.3, 45.8, 12.7, 47.2] minus the union of all geology source coverage in geology-dolomites.pmtiles (bz-geology-carg, pat-geology-carta-geologica, veneto-litologia-250k, swisstopo-geocover, ispra-geologia-100k-inspire, geosphere-geologicunits-500k): areas with no open vector geology, one feature per part, largest first, with area_km2 and mean_width_m (2 x area / perimeter in EPSG:25832) so a viewer can tell thin seams along sheet and source borders from real gaps. Display geometry: opening with radius 0.0001 deg (drops slivers narrower than about 15-20 m), simplified 0.0001 deg, parts under 1e-07 deg2 omitted, coordinates rounded to 5 decimals and repaired. Geology is not extended into the gaps.
